name: John Richards Octagon House

dates.note: The survey's inventory line reads 'Date of Erection. 1853', its narrative says 'The house dates from the year 1853', the Library's item record prints '1853 Initial Construction' and the Wikipedia infobox prints 'Built 1853'. The SAME Wikipedia article's own first sentence says the house 'was built in 1854'. Four surfaces say 1853 and one says 1854; recorded as 1853 with the disagreement noted rather than resolved.

note: Tranche 2, Gothic Revival and picturesque villa cluster, 5 Sep 2026. Added to octagon-house as the type at full size and as the counter-case to the node's own 'it could not grow' reading: thirty-two rooms on four floors, and the survey still records no dimension. The Library's item record prints this in its `rights_information` field; an internal run of spaces in the JSON has been collapsed to one and nothing else was changed. It is the boilerplate the Library prints on every HABS item alike and no licence is read out of it.
